caption:
Big update to our link-in-bio page 🎉

33 open funding calls for clinical and rehabilitation research, each checked against the official call text and grouped by region and funding programme, from Horizon Europe to NIH and private foundations. 12 of them are open to Italian institutions.

New: a page with PhD, post-doc, research and faculty positions in rehabilitation research, updated every day.

Open calls: https://clinical-chaos-dsv.pages.dev
Academic positions: https://clinical-chaos-dsv.pages.dev/positions.html

Which funders should we add next? Tell us in the comments.
